verdict.rationale: Sift documents Review Queues alongside Workflows and shows Queues in the console. It also has a Decisions API for recording business actions like approving or blocking an order, and the founder notes that most customers have a human make the final go/no-go call on flagged users. None of the evidence describes the team-workflow mechanics the story asks for. missing for 10: reviewer assignment, escalation paths, SLA tracking, an audit trail recording who approved what and why, and any hands-on corroboration of queue workflows.
